scope: Invented-object prototype only; no scientific graph, partial pickle, compile, sampler or owner artifact touched

independent_reproduction.fresh_copy_tests: Copied V2 counting.py and test_counting.py into fresh /tmp; all 11 tests passed in 3.995 seconds.
independent_reproduction.post_popen_receipt_exception: Tested actual Popen then injected launch.json atomic write exception; child was TERM-signaled and reaped, terminal recorded exception/cleanup, no complete marker.
independent_reproduction.controller_sigterm: Tested SIGTERM to a controller after worker startup; owned worker termination/reap observed through pidfd and terminal recorded signal 15; no complete marker.
independent_reproduction.cpu_signal: SIGXCPU arrived at configured 2-CPU-second soft limit; terminal label is now cpu_soft_limit_sigxcpu. V1 label was ambiguous/incorrect.
independent_reproduction.post_rename_fsync_failure: Fresh invented run with one-shot injected directory-fsync error after complete.json rename: run raised, seal-failure.json was written, complete.json remained, and verify_complete accepted it using its hash.

supported_v2_improvements: Direct-child exception and catchable SIGTERM teardown paths are materially improved and tested; completion is gated on verified reaped direct child.
V1/V2 complete manifest schema separation test passes; V2 doesn't silently accept V1 manifest schema.
V1 bounded accepted-prefix, tiny bytes/hash oracle, budget, no-payload/no-deserialization, request/source identity, metadata tamper and CPU tests pass in V2 suite.

blocker.finding: Completion publication is not fail/complete separated across a directory-fsync failure after atomic rename. atomic_json renames complete.json before fsyncing the directory. If that fsync fails, run writes seal-failure.json and raises, but complete.json persists; verify_complete only checks listed files and doesn't reject seal-failure.json or require an exact allowed file set. The reproducible run was reported failed but verified as complete.
blocker.correction: Define post-rename fsync failure as indeterminate and make verification fail closed if any seal-failure marker exists; ensure manifest verification requires the expected exact file roster and completion state. Add injected post-rename-fsync regression. Do not treat the current behavior as a durable completion guarantee.

remaining_limits: SIGKILL, power loss, controller process death and uncatchable termination cannot run teardown or guarantee a terminal receipt; documented and not tested.
Cleanup is for a direct child only; the invented worker has no descendants. This is not sufficient proof for future code that can spawn subprocesses.
The source/request SHA pins prove bytes under trusted local generation, not authorization; a locally selected hash is not a signature. Pickle remains non-loadable and no restoration safety is shown.
The source checks/child execution are not protected against a malicious concurrent source-file rewrite-and-restore actor. No hostile filesystem threat model is claimed.
No actual symbolic graph size, runtime, restoration, parity or scientific property was measured.
recommendation: V2 fixes the V1 CPU label and catchable controller teardown gaps under its toy direct-child scope. Fix and test the post-rename completion ambiguity before relying on the completion verifier; continue to prohibit pickle deserialization absent authenticated local provenance and independent restore review.
